description: Preview and edit SQLite / LibSQL database files with a rich UI, SQL editor, import/export, and bilingual interface.
editor.label: SQLite / LibSQL Editor
config.title: SQLite/LibSQL/Turso P&E
config.language: Interface language. auto = follow VS Code language, en = English, zh-cn = Simplified Chinese.
config.pageSize: Number of rows per page when browsing table data.
config.readOnly: Disable all write operations (data edits and structural changes).
config.readOnlyTables: Tables that should be treated as read-only even when the global write switch is enabled.
config.confirmDestructiveActions: Ask for confirmation before dropping tables, views, indexes, or columns.
config.nullDisplay: Text used to display SQL NULL values in tables and queries.
config.maxCellLength: Maximum number of characters shown per cell. Longer values are truncated with an ellipsis.
